Hub / company-study note · Maps to Course 04 (Competitive Strategy), Course 11 (Global Strategy, Macro & Responsible Business), Course 09 (Leadership & OB), Course 02 (Corporate Finance), E2 (Capital Allocation), E4 (Governance), E8 (Investor Relations), E10 (Digital & AI Transformation) · Written 2026-10-25 · Entry point for the nine JPMorganChase notes

  • Source: _ingest/raw/jpmc/ holds 165 records, ~527,000 words (index: index.tsv; texts: articles.jsonl; read-first digest: DIGEST.md). They cover:
  • Dimon's shareholder letters for AR2019–AR2025, read in full.
  • The line-of-business and COO letters for the same years.
  • Ten earnings calls: 4Q19 to 4Q25 Q4s, plus 1Q23, 2Q26 and 3Q26.
  • The 2025 Investor Day transcript.
  • 140 newsroom, IR, Payments/Kinexys, Markets, technology and research items, filtered from ~1,500 candidates; the newsroom holds 468 press releases.

Skipped: consumer, branch and philanthropy items, awards-only posts, quantum minutiae and research outlooks. Investor Day transcripts for 2019–2024 are no longer hosted. JPM mentions in the Tradeweb corpus are used where marked [TW]. This study is about JPMC as a company. J.P. Morgan research on software and AI is covered separately in jpm software sector spotlight 2026. - Core claim: JPMorganChase runs one model: fortress balance sheet + complete client franchise + scale technology, and it argues for that model in public more than any peer. Dimon's letters are policy essays. From 2019 to 2026 the business shifted three ways: - Markets growth moved to financing and Prime. Record $35.8B Markets revenue in 2025, while FICC share sits below pre-COVID. - Payments and Kinexys became the defence of the deposit against stablecoins. - Excess capital built against the Basel endgame is now being redeployed into financing, Apple Card and a $1.5T security initiative, not buybacks.

The stories told most loudly are regulation and competition. Those told least are succession (a co-president race with no date), AI returns (a ~$19.8B tech budget, AI benefits "aren't observable") and venues (zero mentions of Tradeweb, MarketAxess or Trumid, despite JPM playing nine roles toward them).

3. Five patterns across the notes

  1. Doctrine over targets. On capital ("output, not an input"), tech ("table stakes"), AI ("trust me") and succession ("intent"), management answers with principles and declines numbers. Analysts' only quantitative win was the 3Q26 AI-spend correction (jpmc outside voices).
  2. The balance sheet is the moat, and regulation is its price. Markets growth (financing, Prime), the deposit-token defence and the SRI all use balance sheet. That is why six years of letters fight G-SIB, SLR and the endgame (jpmc capital regulation, jpmc capital allocation).
  3. Self-disruption in a separate unit, with the core economics kept. Kinexys keeps the deposit and changes the rail. The CIB keeps the client and automates the trade. Fusion keeps the data. Each innovation protects an existing profit pool (jpmc kinexys deposit tokens, jpmc markets venues).
  4. The competitor list tracks the threat. It runs Big Tech and Walmart (2020) → Apple, Stripe and shadow banks (2023) → Block, Citadel Securities, Revolut, Stripe, stablecoins and "market infrastructure providers" (2025–26) (jpmc mission forces).
  5. Pairs everywhere, one voice on top. Co-presidents, co-CEOs and co-heads below; Dimon alone as strategist, lobbyist and allocator. The succession question is really about who inherits the voice (jpmc people, jpmc succession).

4. How this connects to the other company studies

  • Tradeweb (tradeweb hub): JPM is founding dealer-owner, IPO bookrunner, people supplier (Pluta, Bruni), launch counterparty, algo distributor, client (JPMAM), co-investor (MAXEX, Capitolis), adviser (ICD) and competitor. See jpmc markets venues §5 and tradeweb outside voices.
  • ICE and MarketAxess (ice hub, marketaxess hub): JPM advised MarketAxess on its sale to ICE (Jul 2026). ICE seeks Treasury-clearing approval beside FICC and CME (jpmc capital regulation).
  • Bloomberg, LSEG, S&P Global, Thomson Reuters (bloomberg hub, lseg hub, spglobal hub, thomsonreuters hub): data rivals and partners. Fusion integrates Bloomberg, S&P Global and MSCI data. LSEG's SwapAgent is a Kinexys client. S&P Global Commodity Insights partners on carbon tokenization.
  • Goldman Sachs (goldman hub): Apple Card moves from Goldman to Chase; the new Head of Kinexys came from Goldman Digital Assets; Goldman is a peer in the overhead and ROTCE tables.
  • BlackRock (blackrock hub): the ~$700B ETF servicing win (2021), a named Kinexys client, the first SOFR swap-spread counterparty against JPM [TW], and an ETF voice on JPM's Markets pages.

5. Cross-note open questions

  1. Succession: single CEO-elect by the 2027 Investor Day? Executive chair? (jpmc succession §7)
  2. Rules: final endgame and G-SIB numbers at year-end 2026; SLR treatment of Treasuries (jpmc capital regulation §7)
  3. Venues: after the ICE–MarketAxess and Tradeweb–Trumid closes (H1 2027), does JPM stream more into all-to-all or push its own channels? (jpmc markets venues §10)
  4. Kinexys: revenue disclosure, JPMD balances, Canton (jpmc kinexys deposit tokens §8)
  5. AI: does the 2027 Investor Day restore an AI value number? (jpmc ai tech spend §7)
  6. Capital: where CET1 settles; returns on new capital (financing, Apple Card, SRI) (jpmc capital allocation §8)
